spec-audit.description: Diagnose `.specs/` structure and recommend reorganizations without editing files.

spec-brainstorm.description: Clarify real product intent before changing specs, using focused customer-development questions and simplification options without editing specs or discussing implementation.

spec-change.description: Update current product intent from a user-requested behavior change, preferring existing specs over new specs.

spec-implement.description: Implement behavior from current `.specs/` product intent and verify the code against the relevant specification.

spec-new-document.description: Create a new owning IDD spec, ADR, or spike only when no existing current document owns the area or decision.

spec-check-implementation.description: Check whether implementation behavior matches durable product intent in `.specs/`.

spec-import.description: Import raw source material into a structurally normalized IDD `.specs/` structure.

spec-lint.description: Run mechanical `.specs/` consistency checks without editing files.

spec-normalize-current.description: Perform focused structural normalization of existing `.specs/` intent without changing product meaning.

spec-update-from-implementation.description: Update specs from confirmed implementation behavior intended as product intent.
